seoDescription: Petrina Salema's practice, based in Vienna. Homes and hospitality spaces, a few projects a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.
hook: People usually ask for a nicer room. What they need is a room that shapes life toward how they want to live.
body: I help people fix the rooms that shape how they live, and how guests feel when they stay. I started this practice in Vienna in 2021, after years studying interior design and working in architecture studios. A few homes and hospitality spaces a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

principles.title: Daily life
principles.body: If it only looks good in photos, it is not finished. The room has to hold up on ordinary days.

principles.title: A few projects a year
principles.body: There is only room for a few at a time. That pace is how the work stays careful, and how each project gets the attention it needs.

principles.title: Home and hospitality
principles.body: Your own place, or a place for guests. Same job: rest, people over, somewhere quiet to think.

ctaLede: A step toward rooms that shape what comes next.
